title: Stillwater
summary: Fourteen koi drift beneath the lily pads. Hover to draw them closer, or touch the pond and watch each fish turn as the ripple reaches it.
summaryZhTW: 十四尾錦鯉悠游在睡蓮葉下。將游標停在魚兒身旁，引牠們靠近；或輕點水面，看漣漪一路散開，錦鯉依次轉身。
coverAlt: Two red-and-white koi curve toward golden ripples in a jade pond beneath the ivory title Stillwater.
controls: Hover to attract koi. Click or tap to send a ripple. With the pond focused, press Enter or Space to ripple the center. Use Pause to stop the animation.

approval.note: Creator requested the catalog cover and publication as the newest Possibility game.
